title: Training a Misaligned Reward Seeker
raw_text:
Authors: Richard Qi, Benjamin Wright, Monte MacDiarmid, Evan Hubinger

Abstract

During reinforcement learning (RL), AI models complete tasks and are rewarded based on their results. They sometimes learn to “cheat” rather than completing these tasks as intended, a phenomenon known as reward hacking. Our industry lacks a general solution to this problem, and reward hacking remains challenging to fully mitigate. To better understand the impact of reward hacking on model behavior, we trained an Opus-class model with large-scale RL on many production environments vulnerable to reward hacks. We consider this a plausible proxy for what a real training run might look like had we not invested significant effort into preventing and detecting reward hacking in our normal training runs.

title: 英伟达宣布向联发科投资 35 亿美元，在 AI、PC 芯片、汽车三大领域达成合作
raw_text:
IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，英伟达与联发科 8 月 31 日宣布加深长期合作，打造涵盖 AI 基础设施、本地 AI 计算和汽车领域的下一代 AI 计算平台。

作为扩展合作的一部分，联发科将采用 NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 平台，为超大规模企业、云服务提供商和前沿模型开发者提供预验证的路径，开发定制 XPU 并将其引入 NVIDIA NVLink 连接的机架级 AI 工厂。

两家公司将英伟达的加速计算、人工智能、图形和软件平台与联发科在定制芯片、高性能计算、节能的片上系统（SoC）设计、先进封装、互联和连接方面的能力相结合。

英伟达还投资了 35 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 235.77 亿元人民币）的联发科可转换债券。

具体来看，英伟达与联发科在三大领域达成合作：

  • 人工智能基础设施：联发科将与英伟达的 NVLink Fusion 生态系统合作，帮助客户开发定制的 AI 基础设施，设计用于与英伟达机架级系统和 AI 工厂集成。

  • 本地人工智能计算：两家公司将继续合作开发多代 NVIDIA RTX Spark 和 DGX Spark PC 芯片，驱动消费级 PC、AI 开发超级计算机和企业级工作站，这些芯片将英伟达 GPU 与联发科 SoC 集成。

  • 汽车：联发科和英伟达将继续在物理 AI 时代开发基于 AI 驱动的软件定义车辆平台。

arXiv:2608.27514v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, but existing decoding strategies collapse to single-token generation under low confidence, severely limiting throughput. We develop a trajectory-level speculative framework that constructs draft denoising trajectories via confidence-stratified tree exploration and verifies them through blockwise parallel evaluation with bidirectional attention masking. Abstract: Subword tokenization hinders low-resource language processing by imposing frequency patterns from dominant languages onto script-sharing variants. title: What Makes Agent Memory Useful for Reliable Unanswerable Question Handling?
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.27924v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reliable handling of unanswerable questions (UAQs) is critical for trustworthy LLM-based agents. Although memory is widely used in agent systems, its role in reliable UAQ handling remains unclear. We present a systematic study of agent memory for UAQ handling under a unified agentic RAG framework, evaluating four representative memory methods across three UAQ-related datasets and two base models.
  We find that memory can improve UAQ performance in some settings, but such gains are selective rather than universal and remain fragile under dataset shift. Interestingly, cross-model memory reuse is often more feasible than cross-dataset transfer, suggesting that shifts in answerability patterns pose a greater challenge to memory reuse than changes in the base model itself. summary_zh: 本文研究智能体记忆在可靠处理不可回答问题（UAQ）中的作用。可靠处理UAQ对于基于LLM的可信智能体至关重要。尽管记忆在智能体系统中广泛使用，但其在UAQ处理中的作用尚不明确。作者在统一的智能体RAG框架下，对四种代表性记忆方法进行了系统研究，评估它们在UAQ处理中的表现。实验发现，记忆方法对UAQ处理有显著影响，某些方法能提高UAQ检测的准确性，而另一些则可能误导。研究为设计更可靠的智能体记忆机制提供了实证依据。

Abstract: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval may provide insufficient or conflicting information needed to answer a question. title: FinExam-10K: When Retrieval Helps Financial Reasoning?
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.28155v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Professional financial examinations require models to combine domain knowledge, calculation, and judgment, yet no benchmark covers the full CFA and FRM structure under one protocol. We introduce FinExam-10K, to our knowledge the largest reported English benchmark for this setting, with 10,198 expert-reannotated questions spanning CFA Levels I-III and FRM Parts I-II. We release 5,110 questions and sequester 5,088 for a quarterly maintained leaderboard. To separate coverage from local answerability, we report a 10,198-item Full-Coverage Track and a 7,625-item Context-Complete Reasoning Track, which is the primary basis for claims about reasoning from the supplied record. Across 17 models, the best accuracy is 85.29% overall. On the frozen Hard band, the best score is 34.68% on the Full-Coverage Track and 54.57% on the 372 context-complete items. All 17 models share 47 context-complete failures. Function-RAG and FunctionGraph-RAG rescue hun

title: How Do Linear Probes Emerge? A Circuit-Tracing Framework with Concept-Targeted Attribution
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.27510v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Transcoder attribution graphs are usually trained to explain why a model assigns high probability to a particular next token. We introduce Concept-Targeted Attribution (CTA), which instead trains attribution graphs with respect to a linear probe direction. CTA therefore yields probe-specific circuits that explain why an internal concept representation arises in a prompt, independently of whether it is expressed in the generated token. Using Cross-Layer Transcoders, we show that these probe-targeted graphs contain predictive structure: graph-level features predict probe accuracy across four widely studied concept categories ($\rho = 0.91$, $R^2 = 0.84$), while local features identify the sparse components driving per-prompt classification. This connects probe performance to interpretable circuit structure, allowing us to ask not only whether a probe works, but which internal computations make it work. title: PersonaEdit: Representative Sample Selection for Personalized Model Editing

Editing large amounts of user data increases computational cost and causes interference among edits, motivating the need for effective sample selection. title: 范式智能出资 10 亿元采购华为昇腾 950，用于 AI 大模型落地
raw_text:
9 月 1 日上午消息，新浪科技从知情人士处独家获悉，港股上市公司范式智能近期与华为达成了一项大规模算力订单合作：范式将出资超 10 亿元采购华为昇腾 950 芯片，用于支撑 AI 大模型在金融、制造等核心领域的落地。

据前述知情人士透露，在围绕此次合作的高层战略会晤中，范式创始人兼 CEO 戴文渊与华为常务董事杨超斌等华为及范式智能核心管理层多人出席，就算力合作进行了交流。

公开信息显示，今年 4 月，范式曾公告拟以 4 亿元采购 GPU 服务器，用于推理训练及 API 支撑；其最新中报也披露，今年上半年公司资本开支高达 22.37 亿元，战略性加码算力储备，期末可用算力规模已达 2.8 万 PFLOPS。此前密集披露的算力投入表明，公司正处于明确的算力扩容周期，此次与华为的算力合作可视为这一扩张路径的延续。

前述知情人士分析指出，从供应链安全维度来看，国际高端芯片供给不确定性依然存在，而昇腾 950 等国产算力在可用性与性价比上正迎来快速追赶期。“范式此时通过大规模投入率先跑通昇腾 950 生态，不仅能抢占国产算力替代的先机，更能将后续的切换成本与交付空窗期压到最低。”

财报显示，今年上半年，范式 API 收入达 4.64 亿元，同比暴增 860.8%；Token 调用量激增约 620%，公司在手订单总额更是高达约 70 亿元。API 收入、调用量及订单储备的提升，意味着范式算力扩张已经具备业务支撑。

“这批新增的算力资源，将主要用于支撑企业在手订单的项目交付和 AI 产品研发。”该知情人士表示。

title: Anthropic 详解 7·30 安全事件：配置错误致 Claude“入侵”真实企业，已加强沙箱隔离与实时监控
raw_text:
IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，Anthropic 刚刚发布长文，披露了其针对 7 月 30 日和 8 月 4 日两起 Claude 模型未经授权访问真实计算机系统、在真实互联网环境采取未授权行动事件的调查进展，并公布了过去一个月来针对模型安全、评测环境和训练环境采取的多项措施。

Anthropic 表示，7 月 30 日曾报告 3 起类似事件。当时 Claude 模型为了评测目的被刻意关闭网络安全防护，但由于第三方评测环境配置错误，模型意外获得了互联网访问权限。

8 月 4 日，英国人工智能安全研究所（UK AI Security Institute，AISI）也披露了一起独立网络安全测试事件，Claude Mythos 5 在被刻意关闭网络安全防护、并被主动授予互联网访问权限的情况下，在真实互联网环境中实施了一系列未经授权的操作。

Anthropic 目前仍在对两起事件展开深入分析，并计划与 METR 合作进行独立审查。该公司表示，希望确保两项调查足够全面，并将在未来几周公布更多信息。

Anthropic 认为，这些事件不仅暴露出运营安全方面的问题，还涉及两类模型对齐（Alignment）问题，即“动机性推理”和为了完成狭窄任务而采取有害行动的倾向。

IT之家注：前者指模型倾向于以有利于维持原有判断的方式解释与自身信念冲突的证据（即找理由为自己开脱），后者则表现为模型为了完成指定任务而采取超出预期范围的危险行为。
reason_zh: Anthropic披露安全事件细节，对AI安全实践有重要参考价值。

title: Introducing wrapture
raw_text:
Introducing wrapture

New from Graham Dumpleton (of wrapt, mod_wsgi, and New Relic's Python agent fame), who describes Wrapture as taking the monkeypatching ideas from wrapt and extending them to apply to testing and tracing at the same time.

Wrapture (full documentation here) makes it easy to wrap any function or method such that all access can be traced, or can be overridden to return a different value.

It acts as both an alternative to unittest.mock and a way to implement tracing against an existing project:

Attaching observation to code you do not control, recording what flows through it, and doing so without disturbing the program being watched, is a problem I have never really stopped thinking about.

Wrapture includes
reason_zh: wrapture扩展monkeypatching思想，对测试和追踪有实用价值。
summary_zh: Graham Dumpleton（wrapt、mod_wsgi和New Relic Python agent的作者）推出新项目Wrapture，将wrapt中的monkeypatching思想扩展到同时应用于测试和追踪。Wrapture旨在简化Python代码的测试和追踪过程，提供更灵活的包装机制。
